skills.description: 把 WorkBuddy 技能发布到 SkillHub 的 CLI 流程，含 Windows Git Bash 规避方案
skills.description_zh: This skill should be used when the user wants to publish a WorkBuddy skill to SkillHub via the official CLI, especially when running in Windows Git Bash where the official install.sh fails. Trigger phrases include 发布技能, 发布 skill, publish skill to skillhub, 上传到 skillhub, skillhub 发布, 把 skill 发到 skillhub, autopush skill. The skill covers: verifying the target skill's SKILL.md frontmatter (slug / displayName / version / summary / license), installing the SkillHub CLI, a Windows-specific Python-CLI workaround (download the install kit tarball, extract skills_store_cli.py, run it with a managed Python), a --dry-run precheck, and the final publish command. It also maps common error codes (401 / 403 / 409 / 429) to fixes.
skills.name: Publish to SkillHub
